title: CLCON/58/2016 of Asha Ram AND ANOTHER Vs D. Santhel Pandian AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
CLCON No. 58 of 2016
Hon'ble U.C. Dhyani, J.
Mr. Mangal Singh Chauhan, Advocate for
the applicant.
By means of present contempt petition, the
applicant seeks the following reliefs:
To call upon the
respondents/contemnors and punish them
suitably for having committed gross contempt
and willful, deliberated disobedience of the
order dated 31.3.2015 passed by this Hon'ble
Court in Special Appeal No. 363 of 2013
"Asha Ram & others Vs. State of Uttarakhand
& others" for which cause of action arose
when the respondents have served upon on
15.4.2015 by the petitioner
personally/registered post and again the
reminder has been sent on 29.8.2015 by
registered post the respondents have been
failed to comply with the aforesaid order
according to the direction of the Hon'ble
court which they deserved to be punish
suitably under the provisions of the contempt
of the Court Act.
Learned counsel for the
applicant/petitioner drew the attention of this
Court towards the penultimate of the order dated
31.3.2015, passed by Hon'ble Division Bench of
this Court in Special Appeal No. 363 of 2013
"Asha Ram and others vs. State of
Uttarakhand & others" as below:
We have heard the learned counsel for
the appellants as also the learned counsel for
the Government. Learned counsel for the
Government would submit that the
Government has taken a policy decision and
has issued an administrative order for
absorbing the persons like the appellants in
the cadre of Deputy Education Officer. In the
light of the said submission, the learned
counsel for the appellants has also no further
submission to make.

2
It is the submission of learned counsel for
the applicant that despite service of notices and
service of order upon the opposite parties, the
said order has not been complied with.
One of the objects of contempt
jurisprudence is to enforce the compliance of the
Court, and therefore, instead of issuing contempt
notice, the order dated 31.3.2015 is reiterated
with a direction upon the opposite parties to
decide the representation of the petitioner, in
accordance with law, at an earliest, failing which,
it will be presumed that opposite party has
nothing to say in the matter, and shall be liable
for appropriate action under the Contempt of
Court Act.
In order to remind the opposite parties
with order dated 31.3.2015, a direction is given to
the applicant to place a certified copy of this
order, alongwith order dated 31.3.2015 as also a
copy of representation, at an early date.
Contempt petition is disposed of
accordingly.
 (U.C. Dhyani, J.)
Pooja 09.3.2016
